VI.description: Donor probe for IVI property nodes: niRFSA properties read and written on an IVI session refnum, in the long catalogue spelling NI's export writes and in a short one. NI's converter builds this one; what it writes for each item - code, PropItemName, types, flags - is what the composer must write.

Node.fields: read+Inherent IVI Attributes\3AInstrument Identification\3AModel,write+Vertical\3AReference Level (dBm),read+Acquisition\3ASpectrum\3ACenter Frequency,read+Clocking\3ARef Clock Source,read+Acquisition\3ASpectrum\3ANumber Of Averages
Node.outputs: Inherent IVI Attributes\3AInstrument Identification\3AModel:4210.Model,Acquisition\3ASpectrum\3ACenter Frequency:4210.CF,Clocking\3ARef Clock Source:4210.RCS,Acquisition\3ASpectrum\3ANumber Of Averages:4210.NOA,reference out:4210.reference out,error out:4210.error out
